notes: Two heads, one tail: «كلاهما عن منصور» is written once after the last branch, so it closes both routes (rule 3).
«بمعنى حديث جرير» names another transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route (rule 4).
«وهو ابن مهدي» and «وهو ابن مهلهل» are glosses: left out. The wording differences (الواشمات) are left out.
«في هذا الإسناد» points back to the previous chain; no previous report is supplied, so it stays as written.
